countdown_instruction: Pick up the phone and wait for the beep
consent_text: Allô Souvenirs can share my video on social media (@allosouvenirs). If featured, DM us to get the HD copy.
consent_host_note: Either way, your video is sent to {host}.
consent_18plus: By tapping Continue, I confirm I am over 18.
faq_q2: Will my video appear on social media?
faq_a2: Only if you ticked the option on the previous screen.
faq_q3: How do I get an HD copy?
faq_a3: DM @allosouvenirs if your video is featured, otherwise ask the hosts.
faq_q4: I changed my mind, can my video be removed?
faq_a5: The video is stored locally on the iPad and handed to the hosts. No email or phone number is collected.
faq_a6: Ask a parent or legal guardian to record with you.
